$comment: Likud 2026 primary results (EventResults). No official party document (vote counts or vote order) has surfaced yet, so `raw` is omitted entirely — only `final`, the seated list, is populated. Source: https://plikud.c14.co.il/ (captured 2026-08-18, the day after the primary) — a media outlet, not the party itself; it functions as an unofficial Likud mouthpiece and this list should be read as a media report pending an official one. 'שריון' ('reserved') marks a slot the party leader may fill directly, overriding the primary vote — five such slots (seats 3, 9, 15, 26, 29) are still unfilled on that list and are omitted here, so seat numbers below have gaps. `reason` ids resolve to prose in this event's locale fragment (resultReason): chair (the party leader — elected in a separate, earlier leadership race — heads the Knesset list by that role, not by standing in this primary), reserved (a leader-appointed slot, filled irrespective of the primary vote), women_representation_guarantee, new_woman_seat. Six seated names are not in candidates.json because they did not stand in the researched primary field (party leader, leader-appointed reserved slots, or a district winner outside our researched roster) — they carry display-only locale entries instead. Replace with `raw`, and confirm against an official source, once one is published.
